gloss: by some chance, in the unlikely event

definitions.gloss: by some chance, if by any chance
definitions.explanation: Indicates an unlikely but possible scenario.

definitions.gloss: one in ten thousand, remote possibility
definitions.explanation: As a noun, refers to a very unlikely chance or emergency.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}ったら→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: If by any chance it rains, it will be canceled.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us if by any chance you're going to be late.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{逃|に}げて→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In the unlikely event of a fire, please evacuate immediately.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I got insurance in case of emergency.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If anything happens, please call this number.
examples.notes: {万一|まんいち}のこと = emergency, worst case

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}し→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧⟦{袋|ぶくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ておこう→ておく：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Let's prepare an emergency bag in case of the worst.

notes:
Literally means "one in ten thousand" (⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧ = 10,000, ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ = 1), suggesting very low probability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {万一|まんいち}〜たら/〜ば (if by any chance ~)
- {万一|まんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧ (in the unlikely event)
- {万一|まんいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧ (emergency, worst case scenario)
- {万一|まんいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (in preparation for emergencies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧〜たら (if - general)
- ⟦もしも→もしも：03811_moshimo⟧〜たら (if - emphatic)
- {万一|まんいち}〜たら (if by some unlikely chance)
